lines.text: [warm] Helm to all stations. We are trimmed and running clean, and there is something ahead worth slowing down for.

[gentle] Two rulers, crossed at right angles. That is the whole invention. Every point out there now has exactly two numbers, and every rule you can write about those numbers becomes a shape you can look at.
[dry] So the bead is not drawing the curve. The bead is obeying it.
[reflective] Coming about. Log it and let us see what else is out here.
